findings.comment: Existing and proposed land uses are not shown on the cover sheet. The cover sheet identifies the project as 'Valley View Townhomes' and indicates R3 occupancy classification, but does not provide a summary listing existing conditions versus proposed multi-family residential use.

The overall site plan sheet is too congested to show adequate detail at required scale. The single sheet attempts to display the site plan drawing with all buildings, utilities, and infrastructure along with five data tables, eight text note blocks, benchmark data, and detailed lighting figures, resulting in highly dense visual presentation with minimal white space. Information should be distributed across multiple sheets to ensure clarity and legibility at the required scale.

No dedicated paving plan sheet submitted with the site plan. Paving details and specifications are distributed across the Landscape Plan (Sheet 31) and Construction Details sheets (Sheets 22-28), rather than being consolidated on a single paving plan sheet as required.

applicableAreas: Site plan sheet and grading/dimension control sheets
findings.comment: Legends are not shown on the site plan sheet itself. While legends are provided on Sheet 3 (General Notes) and Sheet 11 (Grading Plan), Sheet 9 (the primary Site Plan) lacks a legend defining line types, symbols, colors, and hatching patterns used to distinguish features on that drawing.

Vicinity plan not provided showing the class of every building/structure in the vicinity of the project site. The site location map on the cover sheet identifies surrounding parcels and streets but does not classify the buildings or structures in the vicinity.

Figure 2.5.1 (site regulations) required as a legible copy with the site plan application cannot be verified as present in the submitted plan set. No reference to Figure 2.5.1 was found in the sheet guides or content documentation.

Demolition plan sheet does not include an overlay of the current/proposed site plan to provide spatial context for what is being removed. Sheet 8 shows existing conditions with demolition callouts but does not overlay the proposed site plan footprints and building locations, making it difficult to understand how the demolition relates to the final proposed development.
